descriptor.scene: MAYA is the subject, mid-stride through her studio's open door into morning sun, laptop under her arm per her signature carry, laughing at something over her shoulder. Behind her through the doorway her workroom hums without her: THREE SMALL CORAL HOLOGRAPHIC SUB-AGENTS, each WEARING ITS GLOWING WHITE SAILOR CAP, tend the desk: one stacking folders, one watering her plant, one updating a wall calendar. On that desk the SUPERCHARGED LAPTOP stands OPEN and ANGLED TOWARD THE CAMERA so its glowing coral SCREEN FACE is visible to the viewer; THE BACK OF THE LID IS NOT SHOWN. She is leaving on time, and the work is carried. Her stride says spring, not winter. Lower-right: the sunlit threshold, calm. Maya's HEAD IS TURNED BACK toward the room she is leaving and her EYES ARE ON THE SUB-AGENTS she is laughing with, not on the camera.
descriptor._caption: Watch what happens when a founder wakes up to it. In the winter she is buried in work only she can do. By spring her agents carry that load, and she spends her days on the part that needs her heart. Multiply her by ninety companies and you can feel the ground move.
negatives: Maya tired, frantic, or at the desk
the back of the laptop lid facing the camera
subject making eye contact with the camera
